line_modifier.label: Line drawing modifier:
line_modifier.description: When held, drawing tools will draw a line from the last point.

fixed_angle_modifier.label: Fixed angle modifier:
fixed_angle_modifier.description: When held, drawing tools will be constrained to a fixed angle.

pan_view_key.label: Pan view key:
pan_view_key.description: While held, click and drag with the left mouse button to pan the image view. Ignored while a text field has focus.

selection_add_modifier.label: Selection add modifier:
selection_add_modifier.description: When held as a selection gesture starts, the gesture adds to the selection whatever the selection mode is. Held together with the subtract modifier, the gesture intersects with the selection.

selection_subtract_modifier.label: Selection subtract modifier:
selection_subtract_modifier.description: When held as a selection gesture starts, the gesture subtracts from the selection whatever the selection mode is. On Linux, many window managers (XFCE, Cinnamon, MATE, KDE Plasma 5) use Alt+drag to move windows, and the press never reaches IntraPaint. Either change the window manager's window-move modifier to Super, or bind this to another modifier such as Meta.

selection_replace_modifier.label: Selection replace modifier:
selection_replace_modifier.description: When held as a selection gesture starts, the gesture replaces the selection whatever the selection mode is. It takes priority over the add and subtract modifiers.

fixed_aspect_modifier.label: Fixed aspect ratio modifier:
fixed_aspect_modifier.description: When held, shape and transform tools will keep a fixed aspect ratio.

eyedropper_override_modifier.label: Color picker override modifier:
eyedropper_override_modifier.description: When held, temporarily switch from the brush or fill tool to the color picker.

compare_original_modifier.label: Compare With Original Modifier:
compare_original_modifier.description: While held in the generated image selector's single view, the original image content shows in place of the focused option.

padding_scroll_modifier.label: Context scroll modifier:
padding_scroll_modifier.description: When held, the scroll wheel changes inpaint context over the image or the navigation panel, with any tool.

zoom_toggle.label: Toggle zoom:
zoom_toggle.description: Switch between close-up and zoomed out views

pan_left.label: Pan left/decrease width:
pan_left.description: Scroll the image view left, or decrease layer width in the layer transformation and text tools.

pan_right.label: Pan right/increase width:
pan_right.description: Scroll the image view right, or increase layer width in the layer transformation and text tools.

pan_up.label: Pan up/increase height:
pan_up.description: Scroll the image view up, or increase layer height in the layer transformation and text tools.

pan_down.label: Pan down/decrease height:
pan_down.description: Scroll the image view down, or decrease layer height in the layer transformation and text tools.

move_left.label: Move left:
move_left.description: Move the generation area left, move active layer left, or view previous generated image option

move_left_more.label: Move left more:
move_left_more.description: Same as "Move left", but in steps of 10 pixels.

move_right.label: Move right:
move_right.description: Move the generation area right, move active layer right, or view next generated image option

move_right_more.label: Move right more:
move_right_more.description: Same as "Move right", but in steps of 10 pixels.

move_up.label: Move up:
move_up.description: Move the generation area up, move active layer up, or zoom in on first generated image option

move_up_more.label: Move up more:
move_up_more.description: Same as "Move up", but in steps of 10 pixels.

move_down.label: Move down:
move_down.description: Move the generation area down, move active layer down, or zoom to show all generated image options

move_down_more.label: Move down more:
move_down_more.description: Same as "Move down", but in steps of 10 pixels.

show_layer_menu_shortcut.label: Show/hide Layers panel:
show_layer_menu_shortcut.description: Show and focus the Layers panel, or hide it if it is showing

navigation_window_shortcut.label: Show/hide Navigation panel:
navigation_window_shortcut.description: Show and focus the Navigation panel, or hide it if it is showing

select_tool_tab.label: Show/hide Tools panel:

select_generator_tab.label: Show/hide Image Generation panel:

select_ControlNet_tab.label: Show/hide ControlNet panel:
select_ControlNet_tab.description: Show and focus the ControlNet panel, or hide it if it is showing

draw_tool_key.label: Switch to the draw tool:
draw_tool_key.description: Activate the draw tool to draw into the image.

eraser_tool_key.label: Switch to the eraser tool:
eraser_tool_key.description: Activate the eraser tool to erase image content.

filter_tool_key.label: Switch to the filter tool:
filter_tool_key.description: Activate the filter tool to apply image filters to brush strokes.

smudge_tool_key.label: Switch to the smudge tool:
smudge_tool_key.description: Activate the smudge tool to smudge image content.

clone_stamp_tool_key.label: Switch to the clone stamp tool:
clone_stamp_tool_key.description: Activate the clone stamp tool to copy image content.

eyedropper_tool_key.label: Switch to the color picker tool:
eyedropper_tool_key.description: Activate the color picker tool to change the brush color.

transform_tool_key.label: Switch to the layer transformation tool:
transform_tool_key.description: Activate the layer transformation tool to move, scale, or rotate layers.

selection_brush_tool_key.label: Switch to the selection brush tool:
selection_brush_tool_key.description: Activate the selection brush tool to mark areas for editing.

selection_fill_tool_key.label: Switch to the magic wand tool:
selection_fill_tool_key.description: Activate the magic wand tool to select areas of similar color.

shape_selection_tool_key.label: Switch to the shape selection tool:
shape_selection_tool_key.description: Activate the shape selection tool to mark areas for editing.

free_selection_tool_key.label: Switch to the free selection tool:
free_selection_tool_key.description: Activate the free selection tool to mark areas for editing.

fill_tool_key.label: Switch to the fill tool:
fill_tool_key.description: Activate the fill tool to fill areas with solid colors.

shape_tool_key.label: Switch to the shape drawing tool:

generation_area_tool_key.label: Switch to the generation area tool:
generation_area_tool_key.description: Activate the generation area tool to pick an image area for AI image generation.

previous_generation_frame_key.label: Previous generation area size:
previous_generation_frame_key.description: Switch the generation area back to the size used before the current one. Pressing it again switches back.

brush_tool_key.label: Switch to the brush tool:
brush_tool_key.description: Activate the brush tool to paint into the image.

brush_opacity_100.label: Set brush opacity to 100%:

rotate_cw_key.description: Rotates the layer when the layer transformation tool is active, or increase font size in the text tool.

tool_action_hotkey.description: Steps the selection mode through Replace, Add, Subtract and Intersect while a selection tool is active.

toggle_sample_merged_hotkey.label: Toggle sample merged
toggle_sample_merged_hotkey.description: Toggles the Sample merged option while the magic wand tool is active. Unbound by default.

toggle_selection_shape_hotkey.label: Toggle selection shape
toggle_selection_shape_hotkey.description: Switches between rectangle and ellipse while the shape selection tool is active. Pressing the shape selection tool's own key again does the same. Unbound by default.
